answers.rationale: For solo travel, Jonah repeatedly requests or accepts free window seats and does not trade them away merely for a somewhat more forward aisle. With standard selection included and no contrary trip-specific note, assign the available windows on both legs.

When traveling with his spouse, Jonah consistently prioritizes sitting together over each person getting a window. The only adjacent pair should therefore be assigned, even though it is in the last standard row.
The established couple-seat preference is adjacency first, ahead of separate windows or a more forward position. On a 2-by-2 aircraft, 17C/17D is the available side-by-side pair and is the best fit.

Jonah repeatedly favors a clean one-stop itinerary with a comfortable connection over modest savings from extra connection exposure. Delta via MSP is the sole one-stop option and has a comfortable 1h35m connection; the small fare premium over the two-stop United routing is justified, especially with no Monday dinner or hotel-arrival constraint requiring the slightly earlier arrival.
